tracks.name: Spotify Global Music Dataset (2009–2025)
tracks.covers: 8,582 tracks by 2,547 artists, released from 1952 to 2025, with popularity scores read once around November 2025. Despite the dataset's name, it isn't limited to 2009 to 2025.
tracks.kept_in_repo: data/raw/spotify_data_clean.csv, unchanged apart from its file name, which had a space
